title: Agents & LLMs concept tiles
description: Every tile rendered by index.html. concepts.json is a flat array of concept objects and is the only database this project has. This schema doubles as the field reference; scripts/validate.mjs enforces the same rules plus the two things a schema cannot express: ids must be unique across the array, and every index.html#<id> link in the essay pages must resolve to a tile.

concept.description: One searchable tile. Adding a short means adding one of these objects — no HTML editing.

id.description: Permanent kebab-case anchor for the tile (index.html#<id>). Pinned YouTube comments link to it, so an id is never renamed once merged. Must be unique across the file.

title.description: The tile heading, phrased the way a viewer would search for it — "What is an AI agent?" rather than "Agent (definition)".

kind.description: Category key. Maps to a filter chip label in index.html's KINDS object: basics = Absolute basics, found = Foundations, model = Model internals, agent = Agents & tools, prod = Production & ops.

def.description: The definition: ONE plain-language sentence, no jargon that itself needs a tile. This is the line a viewer reads first.

note.description: Optional. ONE more sentence of nuance — the caveat, the contrast, or the thing people get wrong. Omit it rather than padding it.

lang.description: Language of the snippet in "code", which selects the renderer in index.html: python/json/trace are syntax-highlighted, mermaid is drawn as a diagram. Required whenever "code" is present, and meaningless without it.

code.description: Optional snippet or mermaid diagram, at most about six lines. Include it only when it explains something the two sentences cannot; a definition-only tile omits both "code" and "lang".

videoUrl.description: Link to the published short. Empty string until the short exists — the tile grows a "watch" link automatically once it is filled in. Must be an https:// youtube.com or youtu.be URL.
